capabilities: Save a checkpoint of a .base view and its shared top-level keys
Restore a checkpoint after a preview that lists the pending changes
Undo the last checkpoint restore from a copy of the file text
Store several named checkpoints per view (Pro)
Compare a checkpoint with the current view without writing (Pro)
extras: Freemium: free tier holds one checkpoint per view; Pro (named checkpoints, compare) requires a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship. Free features need no account. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+. Mobile (Android/iOS) and Linux/Windows desktop untested. After updates it opens a What's new tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat, with a link to notemods.com; the tab sends no data and can be turned off. Sign-in uses the GitHub device flow; no vault data leaves the device and there is no telemetry.
intentEvidence: Bases stores the setup of a view inside the .base file. When you change a sort or a filter for one task, the old setup is gone.
problem: Bases stores a view's setup in the .base file, so changing a sort or filter for one task overwrites the previous setup with no way back.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro

summary: Saves a checkpoint of a Bases view setup in a .base file and restores it after temporary filter or sort changes.
